image_description: A close-up view of a metallic chain, likely part of a necklace or jewelry piece, draped across a light-colored surface. The chain consists of interlinked metal rings with a dark, possibly oxidized or antique brass finish. Some sections of the chain are attached to or intertwined with clear, faceted plastic or glass beads and a white fabric or ribbon element. A green tag with partial text is visible in the lower right corner.
